name: S1 Orchard Boar (64 canvas)
layout: <facing>.png = the object's rotation (frame 0 still); hit/<facing>/0..N.png = the kept roll; alt/<roll>/hit/<facing>/ = refused rolls
tool: animate_object v3 on the object, frame_count 6, keep_first_frame false; south and the side facings are separate groups (their action texts differ)

r1.action: leans back by one pixel as if pushed from the front, then returns to its stance, feet planted, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame
leans back by one pixel as if pushed from the side it faces, then returns to its stance, feet planted, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

r2.action: rocks back by one pixel as if pushed from the front, then returns to its stance, all four hooves stay on the ground, the body keeps its height, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame
leans back by one pixel as if pushed from the side it faces, then returns to its stance, feet planted, the head keeps facing away, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

r3.action: leans back by one pixel as if pushed from the side it faces, then returns to its stance, all four legs stay under the body, the head stays down and facing away, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

refused.south r1: the whole body rises 4-6 px with the feet (frames 2-4)
refused.north r1: the snout swings out to the right (frames 3-5)
refused.north r2: the head and tusks spread out to both sides (frames 2-4)

measured.how: each kept frame against the rotation of its facing: xor = mask px changed, alien = px with no colour within 60 RGB of the still inside 3 px (a flash or a new colour), dx/dy = centroid shift px, top/bottom = box edge change px (negative = up)

flags: south r2: the body rises 2.9 px at frame 3 with the hooves 3-4 px (the 3 px line); home by frame 5
north r3: the hind hooves lift 5 px at frame 3 only
